source_citation.text: Interviews for a foster home screening must be documented and must include at least: one individual interview with each prospective foster parent; one individual interview with each child three years old or older living in the home; ... a minimum of two interviews ... with neighbors, school personnel, clergy, or any other community member ... unrelated to the foster parents.

source_citation.text: You may verify only one spouse if: the spouse whom you verify will be the only one involved in the care of any foster child in the home; the spouses have been living apart for at least two years; and ... you determine that the spouse will not have unsupervised access to foster children.

source_citation.text: A home that is the primary residence of the foster parent(s) and provides care for six or fewer children or young adults, under the regulation of a child-placing agency. Also referred to as a 'foster home' in this chapter.
source_citation.page_or_section: 26 Tex. Admin. Code Section 749.43(29). RESOLVED, SUPERSEDES the old draft entry: the separate 'foster group home' (7-12 children) category from the 2014 PDF's Section 749.43(23)-(24) was DELETED in an April 2022 recodification -- confirmed via HHS's own revision memo. All foster homes are now capped at six children/young adults under one definition. Do not use the old two-tier size split.

source_citation.text: Submit to supervisor for approval within 15 calendar days of determining screening is necessary. Supervisor forwards to regional ICPC coordinator, then to Texas Interstate Compact Office (TICO).

This is the REGULAR-track timeline -- the parallel expedited track (req-tx-sending-expedited-eligibility-and-3-day-submission) applies instead when fact.placement.is_expedited_request is true. Like the CA sending-side file, this ontology doesn't hard-code the either/or exclusivity between the two tracks -- that branching logic belongs in the engine, not the requirement data.

source_citation.text: Qualifying relationships: parent, stepparent, grandparent, adult sibling, adult aunt/uncle, guardian (cousins, great-aunts, great-uncles, and fictive kin do not meet criteria). Qualifying circumstances (at least one required): sudden incarceration, incapacitation, or death of parent/guardian; child currently in emergency placement; court finding of substantial sibling relationship; child age four or younger. Submit packet to ICPC administrator within 3 business days of court order.
source_citation.page_or_section: DFPS CPS Handbook, Section 4512, 'Expedited ICPC Home Screening.' OPEN ITEM, same treatment as the CA HSC 1522(e)/(g) offense lists: this eligibility test is a real relationship-type x circumstance-type combination rule, not yet transcribed into a reference table an engine could check deterministically. fact.relationship.degree_to_child alone is not sufficient to determine eligibility -- the qualifying-circumstance half (e.g., 'sudden incapacitation of parent') looks like a genuine caseworker judgment call, not something to derive automatically. Keep fact.placement.is_expedited_request as an attested, caseworker-confirmed flag rather than trying to derive it from this rule until someone builds that reference table.
